title: logast retry.yaml
description: Optional. Every retry decision of the service (pack resilience). Then run logast apply .

specific.description: true: its own block resilience.retry.usages.<class>.<method>; false: the shared block of its kind; empty: logast decides (its own block when its settings differ from the shared ones)

values.description: What its own block starts with (default: the shared values): Spring Framework max-retries, delay, jitter, multiplier, max-delay, timeout; Spring Retry max-attempts, delay, max-delay, multiplier

candidates.description: Idempotent HTTP calls nothing retries, by Class.method

retry.description: yes: add @Retryable (a request: one quick retry; a job or consumer: retries with backoff); no: not recommended again; empty: undecided. Say no when a gateway or mesh already retries, or the remote side must not see the call twice
